story.summary: Enable agents to review AI draft responses with full context, confidence score, and editing capability. Split view: query/context left, draft right. [Source: 5-2-draft-review-interface.md]

requirements.requirement: Split view: left (query/context chunks), right (editable AI draft), top bar (confidence, bot name, time in queue).
Draft supports rich text editing, citation highlighting.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Split view with all required fields.
Rich text editor with citation highlighting.

structure.backend: API for queue item details, update draft.
structure.frontend: Review page, split view, context chunk list, editable draft, confidence badge, citation highlighting.
structure.sharedTypes: Queue item DTO in shared package.
